status: v8 proposal derived for Backleaf; values are not claimed to be Meta's internal RGB tokens

rules.normal: canvas, unchanged icon identity, primary content; no card, outline or shadow
rules.hover: neutral hover overlay on the current container, behind icon and text
rules.pressed: pressed overlay replaces hover; it is not a new semantic fill
rules.selected: one continuous low-emphasis selection surface for the identity; paired content, semibold filename; no separate icon plate or filename pill
rules.focus: orthogonal keyboard-only ring around the text identity; preserves the current selection surface and foreground
rules.inactive-selected: paired inactive selection surface/content, same geometry and semibold filename; does not mean disabled
rules.disabled: disabled foreground with no hover/press action; does not reuse inactive-selection treatment
rules.floating: floating surface, subtle edge and shadow; reserved for menus, tooltips and dialogs
rules.rhythm: stable geometry across states; 4/8/16 spacing roles, centered grid, one background owner
